- Align stakeholders and roles
- Confirm scope (models, data flow, SLOs)
- Walk through initial integration plan + timeline
- Identify immediate blockers and next steps

Proposed time slots (PDT):
- Wed 9/22 10:00–11:00
- Thu 9/23 08:00–09:00
- Fri 9/24 13:00–14:00

Suggested internal attendees from Redwood:
- Priyom Das (Implementation Lead)
- Laura Bennett (Customer Success)
- Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer)
- Evelyn Hart (Security/Compliance SME)

Proposed customer attendees (please confirm):
- Maya Rios (Ops lead)
- Adrian Cole (Platform engineer)
- Security representative (we can add if you confirm name)

I've attached a short kickstart playbook draft and a roster template to capture final attendee details. Can you confirm the best slot and who will be owning security/compliance questions on your side?

Once we agree on timing I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks,
